Title: Disk Overflow: Rotatable Application Logs vs DB Core Dump
Trigger_Condition: Disk usage > 90% on partition /dev/sda1
Safe_Action_Tier: Tier 1 (Low Risk) for Logs; Tier 3 (High Risk) for Core Dumps
Blast_Radius: Local partition only. 0 downtime risk if logs; potential diagnostic data loss if core dumps.
Verification_Check: df -h / | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 75) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF disk is full due to rotatable logs in /var/log/app/*.log, compress and archive older logs. IF disk is full due to mysql / kernel core dumps, DO NOT delete; escalate to Database/Infra team.

Title: Background Process Stuck: Worker Thread Deadlock vs DB Saturation
Trigger_Condition: Worker heartbeat missed for > 180s, processing queue stalled
Safe_Action_Tier: Tier 1 (Low Risk) for Soft Thread Stutter; Tier 3 (High Risk) if Database Pool Exhausted
Blast_Radius: Single worker node (Worker-03). Zero client impact if drain succeeds.
Remediation_Command: systemctl restart celery-worker@worker-03.service && sleep 3 && systemctl status celery-worker@worker-03.service
Rollback_Command: systemctl stop celery-worker@worker-03.service && systemctl start celery-worker@worker-03-fallback.service
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF worker thread is in deadlock but database connection pool is healthy, send graceful SIGTERM and restart. IF worker is waiting because Postgres active connections are 100%, DO NOT restart worker (prevents thundering herd); escalate immediately.

Title: Growing Message Queue: Traffic Surge vs Poison Pill Message
Trigger_Condition: Queue backlog exceeds 30,000 messages and consumer lag increases
Safe_Action_Tier: Tier 2 (Medium Risk) with max scaling boundary (Max 10 workers)
Blast_Radius: Horizontal pod autoscaler. Risk of cloud compute cost overrun if unconstrained.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF consumer error rate is < 1% (pure traffic spike), scale queue consumers from 3 to 6 (within hard limit 10). IF consumer error rate > 50% (poison pill crashing workers), DO NOT scale; divert failing message to Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ).

Title: SSL/TLS Certificate Expiration & Key Rotation
Trigger_Condition: Certificate expiration date <= 7 days
Safe_Action_Tier: Tier 1 (Low Risk) if ACME challenge valid; Tier 3 (High Risk) if Root CA Drift
Blast_Radius: Edge API Gateway TLS terminations. Zero downtime seamless cert reload.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF certificate is within 7 days of expiry and domain DNS verification succeeds, trigger automated certbot renewal and graceful nginx reload. IF certificate chain is corrupted or domain mismatch, escalate to Security lead.

Title: Memory Leak in Microservice Container
Trigger_Condition: Container memory usage > 92% of limit, OOMKilled risk
Blast_Radius: Single pod replica in a 5-pod cluster. Zero dropped transactions.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF pod memory leak is linear over 48h and other replicas are healthy, perform a rolling zero-downtime rollout restart. IF all replicas leak simultaneously within 5 minutes, suspect memory exploit / payload bug, escalate to Dev team.

Title: High CPU Runaway Script / Zombie Fork Bomb
Trigger_Condition: Host CPU pegged at 99% for > 10 minutes
Blast_Radius: Can terminate uncommitted analytical data jobs.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF CPU usage is tied to rogue orphan Python process with PPID=1, terminate gently with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL if unresponsive. Verify process is not critical ETL pipeline.

Title: Read-Only Filesystem Mount Due to SCSI I/O Timeout
Trigger_Condition: Filesystem mounted read-only (ro) following I/O error
Blast_Radius: Cluster-wide storage availability.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: Read-only mount often signals underlying SAN/SAN hardware failure or bad blocks. Blindly running 'mount -o remount,rw' can destroy corrupted sectors. Policy mandates Escalation.

Title: Redis Cache Connection Pool Exhaustion
Trigger_Condition: Connected clients > 95% of maxclients limit
Blast_Radius: Redis connection state. Transparent to active web requests.
Remediation_Command: redis-cli config set timeout 60 && redis-cli client kill type normal skipme yes
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF connection pool is exhausted due to idle leaked TCP sockets (> 300s idle), execute timeout config and prune idle connections. Do NOT flush DB.

Title: DNS Resolver Cache Poisoning & Stale Lookup Drift
Trigger_Condition: DNS lookup latency > 2500ms or resolving to loopback
Blast_Radius: Host DNS cache table.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF DNS resolution times out or returns transient NXDOMAIN for internal service discovery, flush local resolver cache and test upstream 1.1.1.1 / internal DNS.

Title: API Ingress Gateway Packet Drop / SYN Flood Rate Limiting
Trigger_Condition: Dropped TCP connections > 5% on external edge
Safe_Action_Tier: Tier 2 (Medium Risk) Dynamic WAF / IP Rate Limit Adjustment
Blast_Radius: Public API ingress traffic. Potential to rate-limit abusive subnet.
SRE_Operational_Judgment: IF dropped packets are traced to abusive single IP range sending malformed requests, inject temporary iptables rate-limit jail for 15 minutes. Verify valid client SLA.
